svg.aria-label: LAN names from Gateway and Service objects: 1. Key: ExternalSecret unifi-dns maps the UniFi API key and host from 1Password item unifi into Secret unifi-dns-secret for the webhook. 2. Watch: external-dns reads HTTPRoutes and Services and takes each record target from the parent Gateway's annotation. 3. Write: The webhook container writes records to the UniFi controller, each paired with a TXT record that names the owner main. 4. Prune: Owned records with no source are removed. A record without its TXT twin is hand-made, and it stays.
